author: new-Beginner (fork of LectWolf)
changelog:
1.6.4
- Use the locale fields supported by the official publishing MCP; retain Chinese release history in CHANGELOG.md
- 适配官方发布字段，中文历史迁移至 CHANGELOG.md，统计功能和权限不变
1.6.3
- Restrict release archives to six reviewed runtime files; reject missing files and symlinks
- Exclude local screenshots, verification records, credentials and session data from the current source tree
1.6.2
- Publish Session Usage Plus as an independently maintained GPL fork with its own plugin ID and repository
- Preserve the original author attribution and all existing usage features
1.6.1
- Simplify child labels to Subagent N or Subagent ? without names or IDs; preserve internal identity
1.6.0
- Show numbered per-delegation selectors only when subagents exist; merge resume calls by verified identity
- Hide redundant agent selectors for main-only sessions while retaining unassigned usage
- Filter model totals independently across all agents; hide single-model controls
1.5.4
- Reconcile total requests and tokens with Main + Subagents + Unassigned using exact measured integers
- Explain unknown ownership instead of hiding the residual; do not invent main/subagent attribution
- Label request counts separately from user conversation turns and aggregate-only usage
1.5.3
- Read completed main-agent inflight checkpoints independently of the full outbox
- Update each available completed request and deduplicate later queue/SQLite/JSONL records
- Preserve measured checkpoint metadata across conversation switches and reloads
- Streaming snapshots are excluded; unpersisted subagents still require a host source
1.5.2
- Merge read-only pending usage with SQLite/JSONL and auto-update every available real operation
- Recover missed file notifications with a lightweight stat fallback
- Make reply details follow the chart scope and selected bar; remove independent detail controls
- Remove yellow diagnostics without weakening identity/deduplication safeguards
- Host 0.18.0 still cannot expose unpersisted usage after its outbox rejects new entries
1.5.1
- Merge real SQLite operations with JSONL by verified operation identity, even when assistant messages are missing
- Watch SQLite/WAL changes; retain known usage on read failures and reject stale session responses
- Display unknown ownership and aggregate-only coverage without fabricated reply data
1.5.0
- Update completed model output usage automatically for main and delegated agents
- Replace scope dropdowns with themed global and per-section buttons
- Keep known usage visible while running and distinguish pending usage from read failures
1.4.0
- Separate main and delegated agent usage by verified call identity, even with the same model
- Add global and independent section scope selectors with total as default
- Deduplicate usage and flag unavailable or incomplete data
1.3.1
- Fix uneven chart spacing, stack positioning and clipped selection borders
- Keep the inspected reply after leaving a bar and through ordinary refresh
- Return to the final reply and scroll to the end when new replies finish
1.3.0
- Add per-reply stacked token history above reply details
- Hover or focus a bar to inspect that reply; leave to show the latest
- Preserve history scrolling and reconcile pointer selection after refresh
1.2.0
- Follow the actual visible conversation through a minimal renderer extension
- Add explicit follow/fixed modes and reject stale reports after switching
- Stop guessing the current conversation from timestamps or running turns
1.1.0
- Move Session Usage into the right work panel; /usage no longer opens a window
1.0.1
- Follow PI-Desktop UI language
description: Session usage in the right work panel, automatically following the visible conversation. /usage refreshes the current conversation without opening a window.

en.name: Session Usage Plus
en.description: Session usage in the right work panel, automatically following the visible conversation. /usage refreshes the current conversation without opening a window.
en.safetyNotes: Reads local usage metadata and main-window session identity attributes only. renderer.extension is high risk because it runs in the host document; this extension does not read transcript/draft text, use internal IPC, or send data off-device.
